verdict.rationale: The Comptroller documents Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for businesses with many outlets, leases, schedules or authorities, a first-party batch filing channel. It also offers 'Close One or More Locations' as a multi-item action, and the open-data Socrata rail allows bulk keyless reads of registration data. However, the only evidence is a single line per feature: no details on EDI formats, limits or automation, and no public API for bulk write operations, since Webfile sits behind authenticated eSystems sessions. Missing for 10: documented bulk-operation specs (EDI formats, batch sizes, error handling), a programmatic API for bulk filing/payment/account changes, hands-on or independent corroboration.
